taylor: Quick note: running a small prefill-and-handoff probe for new q-format models. calling it prefill-probe-1.

mina: link?

taylor: paste below, super short.

taylor: Goal: 1) cut token cost, 2) keep longform coherence. approach: 2-4 token cheap prefill + confidence proxy -> selective full decode.

eli: numbers?

taylor: pilot sims: rlh-13b-q4 baseline 1150 tps -> 2100 tps with prefill (1.83x). 70b baseline 330 -> 485 (1.47x). quality delta small on short chats, ~0.35 rerank hit on >1k token prompts.

mina: latency p99?

taylor: p99 up ~10% in batch tests. plan: disable on latency routes, enable on throughput routes.

zoe: safety check?

taylor: will run safety classifier + 200 human longform raters before canary. also logging per-request decision tags.

opsbot: canary-scheduler: queued prefill-probe-1 on dedicated pool (ETA 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC).

mina: action items: taylor push artifact, eli create eval csv, zoe draft safety checklist.

taylor: will push artifacts to /shared/onboard/prefill-probe today. ping for access.
